ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   C. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   D. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   B. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

10. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

12. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   D. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

15. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   C. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain The Battles of Badr and Uhud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07 7.4 Farewell Pilgrimage 03 Tota and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The Treaty of Hudaibiya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Farewell Pilgrimage 03 Total Number of Lessons 90 Page 12 of 73 1 1.0 QUR’AN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
